SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(inv.onhand_qty * item.standard_cost), 2), 0) FROM inv_inventory inv INNER JOIN md_item item ON item.item_id = inv.item_id WHERE inv.onhand_qty > 0
AND inv.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

SELECT inv.inventory_id AS inventoryId, inv.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, inv.location_id AS locationId, inv.item_id AS itemId, inv.batch_id AS batchId, mi.item_code AS itemCode, mi.item_name AS itemName, mb.batch_no AS batchNo, wl.location_code AS locationCode, inv.onhand_qty AS onhandQty, inv.available_qty AS availableQty, inv.reserved_qty AS reservedQty, inv.frozen_qty AS frozenQty, inv.inventory_status AS inventoryStatus, inv.last_txn_at AS lastTxnAt FROM inv_inventory inv LEFT JOIN md_item mi ON mi.item_id = inv.item_id LEFT JOIN md_batch mb ON mb.batch_id = inv.batch_id LEFT JOIN wh_location wl ON wl.location_id = inv.location_id ORDER BY inv.inventory_id DESC
